source.source_locator: 消防法 第13条の2第2項

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 取扱い・立会い可能な危険物の種類は免状の種類に応じて総務省令で定める。
evidence.tested_misconception: 免状を一つ持てば種類に関係なくすべての危険物を同じ範囲で扱える。
evidence.reasoning_path: license type -> delegated scope rule -> permitted material range

independent_review.rationale: Article 13-2(2) supports license-dependent handling/attendance scope; tests delegated scope rather than class enumeration.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the 600Q quality-not-quota contract. The 23 accepted candidates cover distinct statutory roles, duties, authorities, temporal boundaries, eligibility routes, enforcement triggers, or emergency obligations.
